item.title: The grass and vegetation on the verge is significantly overgrown and has become obstructive to the adjacent footpath. This has been an ongoing issue for a number of years, with the vegetation repeatedly becoming overgrown and encroaching onto the path, restricting the available walking space and making it difficult for pedestrians to pass safely. The vegetation is also growing into/against the neighbouring property fence and is causing damage to the fence. The verge appears to be poorly maintained and requires cutting back and clearing to restore safe access to the footpath and prevent further damage to the property., 16th September
